method.scope: a41 matched sequence final captured PNGs; manual results separate from adaptive observations
method.metric: RGB MAE/RMSE in 8-bit values; change if any RGB channel differs by more than zero
method.ssim: RGB channel mean; uniform 7x7; K1=.01, K2=.03, data_range255; sample covariance49/48; valid windows
method.alpha: composited over black, no resize/registration/color-space linearization for metrics
method.comparisonImage: native-size before/after and absolute RGB difference x8 clipped255
method.contactSheet: aspect-preserving thumbnails inside320x240 cells; metrics always use original PNGs
method.performance: image analysis only, no browser or GPU/CPU benchmark; not FPS or an all-frame quality guarantee
method.serialization: root explicitly paused GPU/audio queues for this analysis interval
method.visibility: raw render samples do not record visibility; PASS does not prove every sample was visible
method.historical: ec5 and initial165 artifacts are not relabeled or included

interpretation.manual: 61 captured PNG pairs: 47 byte/pixel identical, 14 nonzero. Every nonzero pair and 15 representative high-desktop pairs visually reviewed (26 unique manual pairs).
interpretation.nonzeroRegions: 6 Sphere procedural dome captures including a repeated forest capture; 8 live-screen captures. The bounding boxes and visual review place all differences inside those regions.
interpretation.causality: Changed primitive interpolation/roundoff, render order and full-app state changes coexist; no isolated A/B proves the dome cause. Broadcast pose differences are consistent with the intentional fresh-frame update, not proof of sole causality.
interpretation.qualityLimit: No large structural loss was seen in the inspected manual snapshots. SSIM is not an automatic quality pass and unchanged dark regions can dominate it; temporal behavior and real-device quality require separate checks.
interpretation.adaptive: Both final presets low, but renderScale 0.85 vs0.6; separate quality/performance tradeoff observation, excluded from manual same-quality counts.
